first_failure.message: The managed server has unexpected descendants; no process was terminated.

confirmed.phase: The first ToolHelp PID/parent-PID snapshot gave the synthetic launcher one direct child, and that child had a descendant. Selection stopped before checking the child identity, probing the interpreter or terminating a target.

diagnosis.missing_evidence: The original failure contains no descendant identity or creation time, so the cause of the unexpected PID/parent-PID relationship cannot be determined.
diagnosis.followup: The existing disposable Windows venv fixture records the resolver's original snapshot without changing its return value. On failure only, it adds the expected synthetic PIDs and related PID/parent-PID, executable basename, creation time and existence/read status to the original exception note. No command line, environment, full image path, timeout, assertion, product guard or cleanup behavior is changed.
diagnosis.retry_bound: One new CI run after adding diagnostics; a passing retry alone does not establish the root cause or a product fix.

scope: Read-only CI evidence and disposable fixture diagnostics; no internal execution, deployment, process guard relaxation, merge or remote retry was performed.
